purpose: Small human-viewable PNG reference batch for Kanto starter box icons in the Switch-era 68x56 format. Public reference only; not yet verified against a retail target build.
rights_note: PokéSprite is MIT-licensed as a project; contributors document that raw sprite files were originally ripped by Zhorken and Kaphotics. Third-party Pokemon/game-image rights are not assumed to be granted by the project software license.
notes: PokéSprite documents that the 68x56 box-sprite format began with Let's Go Pikachu/Eevee. These files remain public visual references until target-build identity is independently verified.
